name: Maximum Classes Are Strictly One-Auxiliary Sections
scope: Finite binary classes under the minor-atlas displayed-coordinate conventions.
statement: Maximum classes require no auxiliary coordinate; $(Q_2\setminus\{11\})\times Q_1$ has minimum auxiliary count one.
proof: Maximum classes require no auxiliary coordinate; $(Q_2\setminus\{11\})\times Q_1$ has minimum auxiliary count one.
